content:
nora: quick sync - we need to finalize the rollout telemetry contract so runtime + infra dashboards can compare canaries reliably. thinking to lock fields today.
devon: +1. main constraints: cardinality and signal alignment across runtime vs infra exports.
ashley: what are the must-have tags? route, region, model_variant, quota_class? also need a stable canary_id.
kai: yes to those. add routing_policy (for cost/routing experiments) and cache_hit boolean (kv/prefix). avoid user_id.
liam: also include batch_size and queue_time for latency deltas. queue_time is often the hidden regressor.
ops-bot: Note: telemetry cardinality warning: high-cardinality labels may be filtered upstream. See https://go/replay/telemetry-cardinality
nora: proposal (minimal schema): rollout_signal_v1 payload with these dimensions: route, region, model_variant, canary_id, routing_policy, quota_class. metrics: request_count, tokens_in, success_count, failure_count, latency_ms_p50/p95, queue_time_ms_p95, batch_size_avg, cache_hit_rate.
ashley: sounds good. how do we handle sampling? full traces are expensive.
devon: sampling rules: always sample failures; sample 10% of high-token requests (tokens_in > 512); 1% global for normal requests. tag sampled=true. ensures traceable regressions.
kai: runtime will emit two streams: aggregated metrics (OTLP/metrics) and sampled traces (OTLP/traces). we'll add header propagation X-RDW-Canary to correlate.
liam: dashboard panels need delta panels: per-route p95 delta between control/canary, token-weighted error rate, and a heatmap by region+routing_policy.
nora: alerting: create regression alert when p95 increases > 15% AND error_rate increases > 0.5% over baseline for 10m. require at least 1000 requests in the window to avoid noise.
ashley: cardinality limits: route + model_variant + region + routing_policy is allowed. don't add quota_id. quota_class ok. we should document exact label whitelist for metrics ingestion.
devon: wire example (small):

```json
{
  "schema": "rollout_signal_v1",
  "route": "completions.generate",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "model_variant": "ggml-13b-q4",
  "canary_id": "2026-03-20-canary-A",
  "routing_policy": "latency-first",
  "quota_class": "paid-tier",
  "metrics": {
    "request_count": 1234,
    "tokens_in": 45210,
    "success_count": 1228,
    "failure_count": 6,
    "latency_ms_p95": 212,
    "queue_time_ms_p95": 18,
    "batch_size_avg": 2.3,
    "cache_hit_rate": 0.37
  },
  "sampled": "partial",
  "sampled_traces_link": "https://traces.internal/trace/abcd1234"
}
```
kai: runtime can emit that JSON over kafka topic `telemetry.rollout_signals` and infra will aggregate into metrics pipeline. please escape sensitive urls.
liam: for dashboards, prefer pre-aggregated delta metrics in analytics db to keep queries fast. e.g., precompute control_vs_canary_p95_delta per 5m bucket.
nora: ownership: ashley -> draft telemetry schema PR; kai -> runtime export & header; liam -> dashboard panel templates; devon -> quota/cardinality policy doc. timeline: PRs this week, runtime impl next week.
ashley: I'll open the PR by EOD. will include label whitelist and sampling table.
kai: I'll stub the kafka producer and OTLP exporter, will add tests for header propagation.
devon: I'll draft the cardinality policy and submit to infra-pipeline for ingestion allowlist.
liam: I'll create a placeholder dashboard and share panel wireframes in #eng-platform-design.
nora: perfect. final ask: please include an explicit example for a failure-sampled payload (error_type and stack snippet redacted) and add a note about redaction.
ashley: will do. tagging note: use `routing_policy` value set, avoid freeform strings.
ops-bot: Reminder: create an RFC if schema will be long-lived or used cross-teams.
nora: good call. we'll mark this as RFC soon after PR. thanks all :raised_hands:
